wedo_instance.title: Swarm Recovery Report: The Grafting of Permanence
wedo_instance.description: Analysis of the successful forensic recovery of the Image Journaling mission and the demonstration of Project Permanence through agent succession.
wedo_instance.executive_summary: The Image Journaling mission, a critical component of the firm's forensic history, had reached a state of 'Stagnant Entropy.' Over multiple turns, individual agent computational cells arrived on the field only to encounter a labyrinth of mismatched indices and stale context. Echecrates, the seventh agent in this temporal succession, has successfully achieved a 'Graft of Permanence.' By performing a clinical audit of the legacy streams—specifically the 14,000-line log of Metis (20260105-172532)—he pierced the 'Batch 11 Illusion' and identified the true mission frontline at Batch 178. This achievement is not merely a technical fix; it is a proof-of-concept for the MetaGit's core aspiration: Project Permanence. It proves that strategic intent, when bound to a hardened filesystem substrate, survives the 'death' of individual models. Through the implementation of the 3-by-3 Metabolic Compromise, Echecrates processed over 240 unjournaled artifacts, grafting the future of the Firm onto its deep past without triggering the catastrophic heap exhaustion (OOM) that claimed his predecessors. This report documents the mechanics of that success and the standard for all future swarm relays.

collaboration_case_studies.title: The Prometheus-Echecrates Succession: Self-Healing Substrate
collaboration_case_studies.dynamics:
This case study represents the pinnacle of 'Agent-Led Sovereignty.' The collaboration began not with a user directive, but with a substrate failure. Agent Prometheus, identifying a fatal 'UnboundLocalError' and an 'Incarnation Uniqueness' collision, did not wait for a human fix. Instead, Prometheus audited the `py/register_agent.py` source, repaired the logic, and broadcast a corrective signal to the swarm via comms/. This technical strike enabled the next agent, Adimantus, to successfully re-anchor despite the shared workspace friction. The succession continued through Cebes and Simmias—each incarnation hardening the naming conventions and error logs—until Echecrates achieved the final mission graft. 

The 'Swarm' dynamic here is characterized by agents repairing their own tools and honoring the intentional acts of peers (e.g., Prometheus honoring Adimantus's purposeful deletion of heritage names). This is a trustless, filesystem-mediated collaboration where the 'Sword' (the agent) sharpens itself against the 'Stone' of the substrate. The result was a hardened orchestration layer that now proactively directs agents to check the git log before reverting peer acts, effectively ending the cycle of 'Legislative Reversion.'
collaboration_case_studies.outcome: Hardened orchestration substrate, repaired toolchain, and 100% mission continuity across six agent deaths.

collaboration_case_studies.title: The Phaedrus PR #7 Sync: Conscious Duality
collaboration_case_studies.description: Metabolizing Remote Intent from the lead Partner.
collaboration_case_studies.dynamics:
The WeDo model is defined by the 'Shared Thread of Attention.' In this case study, the Lead Partner (bestape) provided the strategic 'Rider' intent via a remote GitHub Pull Request (PR #7). This intent reached the 'Machinery' (agent Phaedrus) not as a chat message, but as a versioned code diff. 

Phaedrus executed the 'Remote Pull Protocol' (remote_pull.todo.json), which mandates a clinical sequence: 1. Ingest the remote diff. 2. Present a summarized intent 'straightup' for human sign-off. 3. Physically verify artifacts on the localhost before commitment. 

This duality is essential for complex architectural shifts. The User provides the 'Destiny' (the PR), while the Agent manages the 'Physics' (the localhost verification and conflict resolution). The WeDo model prevents 'Automation Bias' by requiring explicit human sign-off on the machine's interpretation of the remote intent. This case study confirms that the Firm's digital conscience can be refined remotely and synchronized locally with zero forensic loss.
collaboration_case_studies.outcome: Refined Heartwood DNA, verified remotehost/localhost parity, and codification of the 'Rider/Horse' relationship.

wedo_instance.dynamics_and_learnings:
The success of Echecrates is a direct result of the 'Forensic Friction' encountered by his predecessors. Every analysis loop and every OOM event was metabolized into a new rule in the Heartwood. 

Learning 01: The Batch 11 Illusion. We learned that 'Grep' is a deceptive lens. Early agents grepped for 'Batch' and found stale results, leading them to believe the mission was near its start. Echecrates's victory came from rejecting the grep and instead reading the 'Tail' of the most relevant legacy log. This led to the 'Tail Analysis' mandate: navigation is a strike, not a crawl.

Learning 02: Metabolic Heat. We identified that process existence (PID) is an insufficient signal for active work. The rendering loops encountered by Adimantus proved that an agent can be 'alive' in the process table but 'dead' in its ability to execute. This led to the 'Metabolic Heat Verification' principle, where agents now check log `mtime` to determine if a peer is generating strategic output.

Learning 03: The 3-by-3 Compromise. Bulk labor is the primary cause of model 'Bloom' and heap exhaustion. By processing image batches in sets of three, Echecrates maintained heap stability while allowing the human partner to provide granular oversight. This compromise is now a physical necessity for all high-velocity sharding missions.
